missing_points: Method 1: Press the Stop button on the keypad or set control mode to Manual, then address the fault condition and restart
Method 2: Cycle the drive power completely OFF then back ON after confirming the fault condition has been corrected and load is secured
Method 3: Use a digital input terminal (e.g., terminal block inputs used for fault clear command via drive configuration) to signal fault clear after root cause is addressed
The safest method in production is Method 2 (power cycle) after confirming the fault condition has been corrected and the motor load is secured
